stories.title: Berngau in der Oberpfalz: Ein Toter nach Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle

en.title: Berngau in Upper Palatinate: One dead after shots fired during weapons inspection
en.summary: A man fatally shot two people during a weapons inspection in Berngau. The suspected shooter is believed to be in a residential building where special forces are conducting an operation.

stories.title: USA klagen venezolanischen Ex-Präsidenten Maduro wegen Folter an

en.title: USA charges former Venezuelan President Maduro with torture
en.summary: The United States has brought charges against Venezuela's former president Maduro and his wife, with trial proceedings scheduled to begin in June. The charges include drug terrorism and torture allegations.

stories.title: Oberpfalz: Zweites Todesopfer nach Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle

en.title: Upper Palatinate: Second fatality after shots fired during weapons inspection
en.summary: Two government employees were killed during a routine inspection at a weapons owner's residence in the Upper Palatinate. The suspected shooter remains barricaded inside the house.

stories.title: In Berngau: Zwei Todesopfer nach Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle

en.title: In Berngau: Two fatalities after shots fired during weapons inspection
en.summary: A routine weapons inspection in the Upper Palatinate escalated into a shooting incident in which two district office employees were killed. The suspected shooter is barricaded in a residential building.

stories.title: Kriminalität: Zwei Tote nach Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle in der Oberpfalz

en.title: Crime: Two dead after shots fired during weapons check in Upper Palatinate
en.summary: Two people were killed following gunfire during a weapons inspection in the Upper Palatinate region.

stories.title: Russland: Gerhard Schröder trifft Wladimir Putin an dessen Geburtstag in Moskau

en.title: Russia: Gerhard Schröder meets Vladimir Putin on his birthday in Moscow
en.summary: The former German chancellor attended Putin's birthday celebration in Moscow, continuing his controversial relationship with Russia that has drawn criticism for years.

stories.title: Fifa-Chef: Afrikas Fußballverbände stellen sich hinter Gianni Infantino

en.title: FIFA chief: Africa's football associations support Gianni Infantino
en.summary: All 54 African football associations have declared support for FIFA President Infantino, unlike their European counterparts.

stories.title: Kriminalität: Zweites Todesopfer nach Schüssen bei Waffenkontrolle

en.title: Crime: Second fatality from shots fired during weapons check
en.summary: A second death has been confirmed resulting from gunfire that occurred during a weapons inspection.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Kein US-Angriff auf den Iran vor Kongresswahlen

en.title: Donald Trump: No US Attack on Iran Before Congressional Elections
en.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned to the United States after months of operations in the region. Donald Trump has made a commitment regarding Iran policy ahead of upcoming congressional elections.

stories.title: „Alter Freund“: Altkanzler Schröder besucht Putin zum Geburtstag

en.title: "Old Friend": Former Chancellor Schröder Visits Putin for Birthday
en.summary: Former German Chancellor Schröder visited Moscow, where Putin learned of his presence through media reports. Putin subsequently invited him to his residence.

stories.title: Microsoft: Eine Medaille von Trump und Tadel von Vance

en.title: Microsoft: A Medal from Trump and Criticism from Vance
en.summary: Microsoft experienced contrasting treatment in Washington, receiving praise from the President while facing criticism from the Vice President.

stories.title: Gerhard Schröder: Altkanzler übernimmt Aufsichtsratsjob bei Globus-Ableger in Russland

en.title: Gerhard Schröder: Former Chancellor takes supervisory board position at Globus subsidiary in Russia
en.summary: Former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder has joined the supervisory board of the Russian subsidiary of supermarket chain Globus following a recent visit to Moscow.

stories.title: Niederfrequenzen: SpaceX fordert US-Mobilfunker heraus – Frenquenz-Kauf belastet T-Mobile US & Co

en.title: Low Frequencies: SpaceX Challenges US Mobile Carriers – Frequency Purchase Burdens T-Mobile US & Others
en.summary: SpaceX has moved closer to offering mobile connectivity directly from space to smartphones. Competing carriers' stocks declined following this development.

stories.title: KI: OpenAI-Umsatz liegt 20 Milliarden Dollar unter bisherigen Erwartungen

en.title: AI: OpenAI revenue falls 20 billion dollars short of previous expectations
en.summary: OpenAI is experiencing slower growth than anticipated, attributed to a revised calculation method intended to facilitate comparison with competitor Anthropic. Investors have responded with concern.

stories.title: US-Börsen: Wall Street schließt im Minus – Starke Verluste bei KI-Werten wegen OpenAI-Umsatz

en.title: US markets: Wall Street closes lower – sharp losses in AI stocks due to OpenAI revenue
en.summary: Reports of lower OpenAI revenues weighed on US stock markets, while strong demand for US bonds limited increases in bond yields.

stories.title: Bücher: „Dreihundert Männer“ gewinnt den Deutschen Wirtschaftsbuchpreis

en.title: Books: "Dreihundert Männer" wins German Business Book Award
en.summary: Konstantin Richter won the 20th German Business Book Award. The reader's prize went to "Cum/Ex, Milliarden und Moral" by Anne Brorhilker and Traudl Bünger.

en.title: Defense: NATO announces nuclear weapons exercise
en.summary: NATO is conducting its annual nuclear weapons drill with armed forces from 17 countries, including the German Bundeswehr, training nuclear deterrence.
